description_en: Creates an access control instance by calling the CreateACL operation
description_zh: 调用CreateACL接口创建访问控制实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag create-acl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name username --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateACL

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the access control instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the access control instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制实例名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Smart Access Gateway instance to be associated with the access control instance. Valid values:

acl-hardware (default): Smart Access Gateway device instance.
acl-software: SAG app instance
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制实例待关联的智能接入网关实例类型。取值：

acl-hardware（默认值）：智能接入网关硬件实例。
acl-software：智能接入网关App实例
parameters.name: acl_type

AclType.description_en: The type of the Smart Access Gateway instance associated with the access control instance
AclType.description_zh: 访问控制实例关联的智能接入网关实例类型

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The resource group ID of the access control instance
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 访问控制实例所属资源组ID
